# Syntagmax — Git-Based Requirements Management System

> Lightweight traceability, change detection, and impact analysis — fully native to your Git workflow.
> Git-native artifacts with no external database, a declarative metamodel DSL, automatic impact analysis, CSV/TSV traceability matrices, generated verification tasks, and local AI-agent integration.
> Syntagmax is a product by Flyvercity.

## Docs

- [Syntagmax (full page, Markdown)](/syntagmax.md): complete product overview — what it is, features, how it works, and install instructions.
